bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · SAR turned bullish, 30-day next
bias.zh: 承压上升趋势 · SAR 转为看多，下一关口 30 日均线

read.en: AMD rose 5.5% on Oct 27 to $560.26, trading between $538.50 and $563.91. It is above the falling 5-day ($533.8) and 10-day ($540.4) and the rising 100-day ($526.9) and 200-day ($405.5), and below the rising 30-day ($585.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Oct 27 ($502.60), and RSI is 50.
read.zh: AMD 10月27日上涨 5.5%，收于 $560.26，盘中区间 $538.50–563.91。股价位于下行的 5 日（$533.8）和 10 日均线（$540.4）以及上行的 100 日（$526.9）和 200 日均线（$405.5）上方，低于上行的 30 日均线（$585.6）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 10月27日转为看多（$502.60），RSI 为 50。

read.en: The close cleared $535.7, $546.5 and $553–556.8 (Oct 21 close and high), now support. Resistance is $563.9–568.6 (Oct 27 and Oct 15 highs), then $585.6 (30-day) and $591.9 (Oct 14 high). Support is $552.7–556.8, then $538.5–540.4 (Oct 27 low, 10-day) and $526.9–533.8 (100 and 5-day). A close above $568.6 would target $585.6; below $538.5, $527–534.

s.en: Oct 21 close $552.7 and high $556.8, now support
s.zh: 10月21日收盘价 $552.7 和高点 $556.8，转为支撑
